title: Helwit Lingonberry Nicotine Pouches 4mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Lingonberry Nicotine Pouches offer a distinctive, Scandi-inspired flavour with a sharp berry kick and a hint of underlying sweetness. The result is a flavour that feels fresh and crisp. Containing 4mg of nicotine per pouch, this is the mildest strength in the Helwit range. The slim, plant-based pouch fits neatly under the lip and delivers steady nicotine without smoke, vapour or odour. Produced in Sweden using climate-compensated manufacturing, Helwit Lingonberry is a clean, modern choice for discreet, everyday use. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
